name: Unified State Register of Legal Entities (EGRUL/EGRIP)
what: Search any Russian company or sole trader by name, INN or OGRN and download a free official extract with founders, director, address and registration history.
note: Captcha after a few searches. Founders and directors who are private individuals are shown by name but without personal details.

name: Transparent Business (Prozrachny Biznes)
what: See a company's links to other firms through shared directors, founders and addresses, plus tax arrears, headcount, tax regime and mass-registration address flags.
note: The old service.nalog.ru address-check tool now redirects here.

name: Accounting Statements Register (GIR BO)
what: Download annual balance sheets and profit-and-loss statements filed by Russian companies since 2019.
note: bo.nalog.ru now redirects to bo.nalog.gov.ru. Some firms are allowed to withhold reports since 2022.

name: Fedresurs (Unified Federal Register of Facts about Legal Entities)
what: Find company notices on reorganisation, liquidation, net assets, leasing and pledges.
run_by: Interfax for the Ministry of Economic Development
note: Timed out from outside Russia; open from a browser, possibly from a Russian connection. URL confirmed by a Wayback Machine capture (June 2025).

name: Bankruptcy register (EFRSB)
what: Search bankruptcy cases, trustee reports, creditor meetings and asset auctions by debtor name or INN.
run_by: Interfax for the Ministry of Economic Development
note: Returned 401 to our checker; open from a browser. URL confirmed by a Wayback Machine capture (June 2025).

name: Corporate disclosure server (e-disclosure.ru)
what: Read mandatory disclosures by issuers of securities, including annual reports, affiliate lists and material facts.
note: Timed out from outside Russia; open from a browser, possibly from a Russian connection. URL confirmed by a Wayback Machine capture (October 2026). Since 2022 many issuers may withhold sensitive data under government decree.

name: Bank of Russia credit institution directory
what: Check a bank's licence status, owners, branches and the date and reason for any licence withdrawal.

name: Moscow Exchange (MOEX)
what: Find listed securities, trading data and links to issuer disclosures for companies traded in Moscow.
note: Detailed historical data is paid.

name: Rusprofile
what: Search companies by name, INN or person and see ownership links, financials, court cases and contracts compiled from EGRUL, GIR BO and other official registers.
note: Returned 403 or a bot check to our checker; opens in a normal browser. Aggregator: check key facts against the FNS original.

name: List-org
what: Look up companies, their founders, directors and financial statements, with search by director or founder name.
note: Returned 403 or a bot check to our checker; opens in a normal browser. Aggregator built on FNS and Rosstat data.

name: Checko
what: See founders, related firms, court cases, state contracts, inspections and financials for a company in one profile.
note: Returned 403 or a bot check to our checker; opens in a normal browser. Aggregator citing FNS, Fedresurs, zakupki and arbitration court data.

name: Saby (formerly SBIS) counterparty check
what: Check a company's registration data, financials, court cases and tenders, with a reliability rating.
note: sbis.ru/contragents now redirects to saby.ru after a rebrand. Aggregator; full reports are paid.

name: Spark-Interfax
what: Trace ownership chains, affiliations, financial histories and risk flags for Russian companies, the tool most used by banks and investigators.
note: Subscription only; some newsrooms and universities have institutional access.

name: Kontur.Focus
what: Check companies and their affiliations, arbitration cases, liens and enforcement proceedings, with a visual links map.
note: Timed out from outside Russia; open from a browser, possibly from a Russian connection. URL confirmed by a Wayback Machine capture (August 2026). Free trial available.

name: Federal Bailiffs enforcement database (FSSP)
what: Check whether a company has open enforcement proceedings for unpaid debts, fines or court awards.
note: Use for companies; searching private individuals is outside this list's scope.

name: Register of Notices of Pledges of Movable Property
what: Check whether a company's equipment, vehicles or other movable assets are pledged to a lender.

name: Federal Antimonopoly Service (FAS)
what: Read antimonopoly decisions, merger approvals, cartel cases and procurement complaints involving Russian and foreign companies.
note: Timed out from outside Russia; open from a browser, possibly from a Russian connection. URL confirmed by a Wayback Machine capture (July 2024).

name: Ministry of Justice NGO register
what: Search registered non-profits, including foundations and religious organisations, and their filed reports.
note: Timed out from outside Russia; open from a browser, possibly from a Russian connection. URL confirmed by a Wayback Machine capture (November 2024).

name: Federal Customs Service trade statistics
what: Find headline foreign-trade figures published by the customs service.
note: Timed out from outside Russia; open from a browser, possibly from a Russian connection. URL confirmed by a Wayback Machine capture (July 2022). Detailed commodity and partner-country data has been restricted since 2022; use mirror statistics instead.

name: OFAC Sanctions List Search

name: EU Sanctions Map

name: EU consolidated financial sanctions list

name: UK Sanctions List

name: Consolidated Screening List
what: Search several US export-control and sanctions lists at once by company or person name.

name: BIS Entity List
what: Check whether a company is on the US Commerce Department's Entity List, which restricts exports to it.
run_by: US Bureau of Industry and Security
note: bis.gov/entity-list now redirects into the regulations; this is the list itself.

name: Canada Consolidated Autonomous Sanctions List
what: Check Canadian sanctions on Russian persons and entities and download the list.

name: Swiss sanctions search (SESAM)
what: Search Switzerland's sanctions lists, including the measures linked to Russia and Ukraine.

name: OpenSanctions
what: Search a combined database of sanctions lists, politically exposed persons and related companies from dozens of countries.

name: War & Sanctions
what: Look up Russian officials, companies, propagandists, ships and weapons components, with sanctions status in each country.

name: War & Sanctions: foreign components in weapons

name: LeaveRussia

name: UN Comtrade
what: Download partner countries' reported trade with Russia (mirror statistics), useful where Russian data is withheld.

name: GAS Pravosudie case-law search

name: Supreme Court of Russia

name: Official publication of legal acts

name: Memorial political prisoners list

name: State Duma legislation system (SOZD)

note: Timed out from outside Russia; open from a browser. Long-standing official address; last Wayback Machine capture is from 2022.

name: State Duma voting results
what: See how each deputy and faction voted on each Duma bill and resolution.
note: Timed out from outside Russia; open from a browser, possibly from a Russian connection. URL confirmed by a Wayback Machine capture (November 2024).

name: State Duma
what: Find deputies' profiles, committee membership and transcripts of plenary sessions.

name: Federation Council

name: Kremlin (kremlin.ru)

name: Government of Russia (government.ru)

name: Declarator

name: Clearspending (Goszatraty)

name: Electronic budget (budget.gov.ru)

note: Timed out from outside Russia; last Wayback Machine capture is from 2022. Defence and security spending is largely classified.

name: Ministry of Finance federal budget data
what: Download monthly federal budget execution figures, including oil and gas revenue.

name: Federal Treasury budget execution reports

note: Timed out from outside Russia; open from a browser, possibly from a Russian connection. URL confirmed by a Wayback Machine capture (June 2026).

name: Rosimushchestvo
what: Read decisions on federal property, privatisation plans and assets seized or placed under temporary state management.

name: Sberbank-AST

note: Timed out from outside Russia; open from a browser, possibly from a Russian connection. URL confirmed by a Wayback Machine capture (July 2025).

name: GIS ZhKKh

note: Timed out from outside Russia; open from a browser, possibly from a Russian connection. URL confirmed by a Wayback Machine capture (November 2024).

note: Timed out from outside Russia; open from a browser, possibly from a Russian connection. URL confirmed by a Wayback Machine capture (October 2026).

name: Rosnedra
what: Find subsoil licensing decisions and auctions for oil, gas and mineral deposits.

name: Avialesookhrana
what: Read official forest fire figures and maps from the federal aerial forest protection service.
